items:
Sparkling Gulf waters meet the tranquility of Lake Allen. This exclusive home offers an extraordinary 30A experience.

Welcome to Sandcastle by the Sea!

This lakefront masterpiece welcomes up to 21 guests with sweeping views of the lake and the Gulf of Mexico, just a few steps away. This designer 3-storey home features seven professionally decorated bedrooms, offering a stunning blend of coastal elegance and modern comfort. Bright and sunny spaces and expansive outdoor areas for recreation and entertainment.

What You'll Love About This Home:

Sleeping Arrangement

First Floor:
2 King Bedrooms w/ En Suite Baths
Bunk Room with Access to King Bedroom - perfect for families

Second Floor:
Lakefront Master's Bedroom with/ En Suite Bath

Third Floor:
2 Kind Bedrooms (one with adjoining bunk room)
Bunk Room: 2 Twin-Over-Twin, 1 Twin Bed, En Suite Bath
Lakefront King Suite w/ Views of the Gulf and the Lake

A Chef's Dream Kitchen
On the second level, a gourmet kitchen brings everyone together. Outfitted with premium stainless-steel appliances, a gas range, dual sinks, two dishwashers, and a generous workspace, it sets the stage for memorable meals and effortless entertaining.

Outdoor Serenity and Entertainment:
Heated Pool & Spa (on-demand)
Game Room with a Full-Sized Pool Table
Spacious Pool Deck with 65" Outdoor TV
Full Bar & Afresco Dining
Gourmet Outdoor Kitchen
Cozy Outdoor Fireplace
Serene Lakeside Dock

Amenities:
In-home Elevator
6-seater golf cart + Bikes
Beach Chairs
2-minute walk from beach access

Other Things to Note:
Pool & Spa Heating Fee: $75/day
High Chair & Pack 'n Play: Available upon request (add-on)
Age Restrictions: Must be 25+ to book and stay (for non-family groups)
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is in a rural area and on the waterfront. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.
